CENTRAL POLICE Station.
30th April, 1919.
REPORT ON Mrs. Lea Cox at request of American Authorities per D.S.P.
Made by D. S. I. Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.
Sir,
Mrs. Lea Cox, known in redlight circles as "Helen", alias Mrs. Lea Wainschtok alias Mrs. Weissherps alias Mrs. Wise alias Emma Schwartz, came to Shanghai about 1914, and soon after her arrival entered a brothel at No 57 Kiangse Road. She left there about a year later and went to live with an Englishman named J. Harvey, who was then working for the Oliver Motor Garage. While acting as Harvey's mistress, she seems to have carried on with a Frenchman named Madier, and later left both for a German named A. Nielsen. The last named, whom she used to visit at No. 44 Sicawei Road, came into notoriety towards the end of 1915 in connection with an attempt to ship arms to India. Following a seizure of arms in Nielsen's house in March 1914, Mrs. Lea Cox, who was then known by the alias Emma Schwartz, was arrested and charged before the French Mixed Court for being in possession of false papers by means of which she had tried to get a passport from the Consul General for France at Shanghai. She was sentenced on 31st March 1916 to three months' imprisonment and a fine of $2,000.00, and ordered to remain under the supervision of the French Police on the completion of her sentence. On the application of Mr. Musso, her lawyer, the sentence was modified on April 5th 1916 when a further fine of $60.00 was imposed in the place of the unexpired portion of the prison sentence. She left for America some six weeks later, and returned to Shanghai on 11th June 1917.

先生，
Lea Cox 夫人，在红灯区被称为“Helen”，又名 Lea Wainschtok 夫人，又名 Weissherps 夫人，又名 Wise 夫人，又名 Emma Schwartz，于1914年左右来到上海，抵达后不久便进入江西路57号的一家妓院工作。约一年后她离开那里，与一名名叫 J. Harvey 的英国人同居，Harvey 当时在奥利弗汽车行（Oliver Motor Garage）工作。在作为 Harvey 的情妇期间，她似乎还与一名名叫 Madier 的法国人有染，后来抛弃了这两人，转而跟随一名叫 A. Nielsen 的德国人。这名 Nielse 住在徐家汇路44号，她常去探望他；Nielsen 在1915年底因企图向印度运送军火而声名狼藉。继1914年3月在 Nielsen 家中查获军火后，当时化名 Emma Schwartz 的 Lea Cox 夫人被捕，并被控在法国会审公廨持有伪造文件，试图凭此从法国驻上海总领事处获取护照。1916年3月31日，她被判处三个月监禁并罚款2,000.00美元，且令其在刑满释放后继续接受法国警察的监管。经其律师 Musso 先生申请，刑期于1916年4月5日获改判，以额外罚款60.00美元代替剩余刑期。约六周后她前往美国，并于1917年6月11日返回上海。

Edward Cox of the United States Navy whom she married at Shanghai
on 9th March 1918. She went to America later in the same year
and left San Francisco for Manila by the transport "Thomas" on
February 5th 1919.

The man Peasy, Goodyear Rubber Co., with whom Mrs. Lea Cox
is said to be intimate, cannot be traced. J. Harvey, who is now
working for the Central Garage, is probably the person referred
to. A man named Weinstock, who was said to be the husband of
Mrs. Lea Cox, lived at No. 3 Yalu Road in 1916.

The full record of the case in which Mrs. Lea Cox figured may
be seen in the issues of the North China Daily News dated 14:3:16
21:3:16 and 28:3:16. The case is also mentioned in China Press of 6:4:'16,

Mrs. Lea Cox claims to have been born in Kavel, Russia, and
it is said that she spent a good portion of her girlhood in
France. She is now about 23 years old, and her photo is
attached.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,
J. W. Givens
Detective Sub-Inspector.

美国海军的 Edward Cox，她于1918年3月9日在上海与其结婚。同年晚些时候她前往美国，并于1919年2月5日乘坐运输船“托马斯”号（Thomas）从旧金山出发前往马尼拉。

据称与 Lea Cox 夫人关系亲密的 Goodyear 橡胶公司的 Peasy 男子，目前无法追踪。目前在中央汽车行（Central Garage）工作的 J. Harvey，可能就是所指之人。一名名叫 Weinstock 的男子，据称是 Lea Cox 夫人的丈夫，1916年居住在鸭绿江路3号。

Lea Cox 夫人涉案的完整记录可见于1916年3月14日、1916年3月21日和1916年3月28日的《字林西报》。该案亦见于1916年4月6日的《大陆报》，

Lea Cox 夫人声称出生于俄罗斯的 Kavel（音译），据说她的少女时代大部分时间在法国度过。她现年约23岁，照片附后。

S. M. POLICE.
C. I. D.
No. C 1059
Date REGISTERED

Emma Schwartz alias Weinstock, in 1915 lived at
No. 57 Kiangse Road and afterwards removed to Rue de
Consulate where she lived with a Mr. Harvey of Oliver
Motor Garage. She was visited by A. Neilson of 44
Siccawei Road. She was arrested on 6-3-16 in connection
with the A. Neilson Arms Case. She was charged with being
in possession of a forged registration certificate, in
name of Emma Schwartz purporting to have been registered
at French Consul. in Moscow, and also with attempting to
obtain from French Consul here a passport with this
forged certificate.

She was sentenced on 31-3-16 to 3 months imprisonment
and a fine of $2,000 and ordered on completion of sentence
to remain under special supervision of the French Police.

On the 5-4-16 the above sentence was reduced on
application of G.D. Musso to a fine of $60.00 being
added to original fine, to take the place of prison
sentence, which was paid and she was released same date.

Her husband, whose name is Weinstock,
living at No. 3 Yalu Road

Emma Schwartz，又名 Weinstock，1915年居住在江西路57号，随后搬至领事馆路（Rue de Consulate），与奥利弗汽车行的 Harvey 先生同居。徐家汇路44号的 A. Neilson 曾探访她。她于1916年3月6日因 A. Neilson 军火案被捕。她被指控持有一张伪造的注册证书，该证书以 Emma Schwartz 之名声称在莫斯科法国领事馆注册，并指控其试图凭此伪造证书向本地法国领事馆申请护照。

1916年3月31日，她被判处三个月监禁并罚款2,000美元，并令其在刑满释放后继续接受法国警察的特别监管。

1916年4月5日，经 G.D. Musso 申请，上述判决被减轻，在原罚款基础上增加罚款60.00美元，以代替监禁刑罚，罚款已缴纳，她于同日获释。

其丈夫名为 Weinstock，
居住在鸭绿江路3号
